Solution:
¢ Test your custom transformations to ensure they work as
expected.
¢ Compare the expected output with the actual output.
Code Example (PySpark):
def filter_adults(df):
return df.filter(df.age >= 18)
# Sample DataFrame
data = [(1, "Alice", 30), (2, "Bob", 15)]
schema = ["id", "name", "age"]
df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
# Expected Result
expected_data = [(1, "Alice", 30)]
expected_df = spark.createDataFrame(expected_data, schema)
# Run test
result_df = filter_adults(df)
assert result_df.collect() == expected_df.collect(), "Business logic
failed!"
